description: Exploratory, predefined one-month HDFC holdings test; no strategy tuning from these outcomes
universe: Union of stocks held in either of each scheme's two latest adjacent monthly snapshots; exclude IN9 securities
zero_signal_policy: Assign score zero to unchanged eligible stocks; do not equate missing corporate-action review with zero
quantity_policy: Require documented action review for each stock and every scheme comparison in which it appears
primary_diagnostic: Date-wise Spearman rank correlation of signal score with subsequent benchmark-excess return, using midranks for ties
return_groups: Negative, zero and positive score; tied scores stay in the same group; show counts and mean gross excess return
top_stock_result: Existing top-two equal-weight cohort backtest, 25 basis points round-trip cost; skip rather than replace a missing top stock
comparison_policy: Report each signal's eligible coverage and a paired weight-versus-quantity correlation on common stock/date observations
missing_data_policy: Never fill missing stock returns, actions or historical disclosures; report dropped assets and skipped cohorts
inference_policy: Descriptive only; the short history, provisional older publication cutoffs and incomplete historical universe do not support a confirmatory significance claim
flow_adjustment: Deferred until a defensible scheme flow estimate is available
